reference_sql:
SELECT product_id
FROM competitor_prices
WHERE competitor = 'Bliksem'
  AND CAST(observed_ts AS DATE) = DATE '2025-05-13'
EXCEPT
SELECT product_id
FROM competitor_prices
WHERE competitor = 'Stroomhuis'
  AND CAST(observed_ts AS DATE) = DATE '2025-05-13'
alternatives: SELECT b.product_id FROM competitor_prices b LEFT JOIN competitor_prices s ON s.product_id = b.product_id AND s.competitor = 'Stroomhuis' AND CAST(s.observed_ts AS DATE) = DATE '2025-05-13' WHERE b.competitor = 'Bliksem' AND CAST(b.observed_ts AS DATE) = DATE '2025-05-13' AND s.product_id IS NULL GROUP BY b.product_id

SELECT product_id FROM competitor_prices WHERE competitor = 'Bliksem' AND observed_ts >= TIMESTAMP '2025-05-13 00:00:00' AND observed_ts < TIMESTAMP '2025-05-14 00:00:00' EXCEPT SELECT product_id FROM competitor_prices WHERE competitor = 'Stroomhuis' AND observed_ts >= TIMESTAMP '2025-05-13 00:00:00' AND observed_ts < TIMESTAMP '2025-05-14 00:00:00'

other_way.sql: SELECT b.product_id FROM competitor_prices b LEFT JOIN competitor_prices s ON s.product_id = b.product_id AND s.competitor = 'Stroomhuis' AND CAST(s.observed_ts AS DATE) = DATE '2025-05-13' WHERE b.competitor = 'Bliksem' AND CAST(b.observed_ts AS DATE) = DATE '2025-05-13' AND s.product_id IS NULL GROUP BY b.product_id
other_way.tradeoff: A LEFT JOIN with IS NULL finds the same products, but the Stroomhuis conditions must sit in ON, and repeats need a GROUP BY.
